title: 入境與海關
when: 1/18 卡加利或愛德蒙頓機場
tips: 台灣護照入境加拿大要先上網申請 eTA。海關可能會問待多久、住哪裡、錢夠不夠，準備好回程機票、姊姊的地址電話、旅遊保險單。加拿大對肉類（含肉鬆、肉乾、泡麵調味包裡的肉）、新鮮蔬果檢疫很嚴，帶了就在申報單勾 Yes。聽不懂可以說 "Mandarin, please." 請求中文翻譯。

dialogue.en: Hello. Passport, please.
Here you are.
What's the purpose of your visit?
We're visiting our daughter. She lives in Calgary.
dialogue.zh: 我們來看女兒，她住在卡加利。

dialogue.en: How long are you staying?
About four months. We go home in May.
Do you have a return ticket?
Yes. Here is our return ticket.
dialogue.zh: 有，這是我們的回程機票。

dialogue.en: Are you bringing any food, plants or meat?
dialogue.zh: 你有帶任何食物、植物或肉類嗎？

dialogue.en: Yes, I want to declare some dried food and tea.
dialogue.zh: 有，我要申報一些乾貨和茶葉。

dialogue.en: Do you have travel insurance?
Yes, we do. Here is the paper.

keyPhrases.en: Sorry, my English is not very good.
Can I have a Mandarin interpreter, please?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以給我一位中文翻譯員嗎？

keyPhrases.en: This is my daughter's address and phone number.
keyPhrases.zh: 這是我女兒的地址和電話。

keyPhrases.en: Please speak slowly.
Where is the baggage claim?

title: 跟鄰居打招呼與閒聊
tips: 加拿大人很愛聊天氣，冬天常說 "Cold enough for you?"（夠冷吧？）。不用講很長，笑著回一兩句就很禮貌。加拿大人常說 sorry，連不是他的錯也會說，這是客氣的意思。

vocab.neighbour: 鄰居（加拿大拼法，美式是 neighbor）
vocab.Cold enough for you: 夠冷吧？（冬天常見玩笑問候）
vocab.driveway: 車道（房子前面停車的地方）

dialogue.en: Hi there! You must be the new neighbour.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！你一定是新來的鄰居。

dialogue.en: Hello! We are visiting our daughter. Nice to meet you.
dialogue.zh: 你好！我們來看女兒，很高興認識你。

dialogue.en: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?
dialogue.zh: 我也很高興認識你。你們從哪裡來的？

dialogue.en: We are from Taiwan.
Cold enough for you?
Yes, it's freezing! Taiwan is much warmer.
dialogue.zh: 對，冷死了！台灣暖和多了。

dialogue.en: Ha, you'll get used to it. Do you need help with the snow?
dialogue.zh: 哈，你會習慣的。需要幫忙鏟雪嗎？

dialogue.en: Thank you, that's very kind. We're okay.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，你人真好，我們可以的。

dialogue.en: Thank you for clearing our driveway.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你幫我們清車道的雪。

dialogue.en: No problem. Have a good one!
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，祝你有美好的一天！

dialogue.en: You too. Take care!

keyPhrases.en: Good morning! Nice day today.
We are here for four months to help with the grandkids.
keyPhrases.zh: 我們來四個月，幫忙照顧孫子。

keyPhrases.en: Sorry, I don't understand. My daughter speaks English.
keyPhrases.zh: 抱歉我聽不懂，我女兒會說英文。

keyPhrases.en: Your dog is very cute.
See you later!

title: 路牌與交通號誌
tips: 亞伯達開車重點：①紅燈可以右轉，但要先完全停下，看到 NO RIGHT TURN ON RED 就不行。②四向停車路口（All-way stop）先到先走，同時到讓右邊的車先走。③學校、遊戲區時速限 30 公里，看清楚牌子寫的時段。④速限單位是「公里」，牌子常寫 MAXIMUM。⑤下雪時 Snow Route 路段可能禁止停車，會被拖吊。

words.note: 先到先走；同時到，讓右邊的車先走。
減速，讓其他車或行人先走。
例如 MAXIMUM 50 = 時速最高 50 公里。
宣布停車禁令時不能停，會被拖吊。

words.zh: 立體停車場（加拿大說法）
身障專用停車位（不能停）
洗手間（加拿大最常用的說法）

title: 加油與冬天用車
tips: 加拿大多數加油站可以在加油機直接刷卡，但台灣的信用卡常會被要求輸入「郵遞區號」而無法使用，這時就進店裡說要先付款（prepay）。油價以「公升」計算。零下 15 度以下，車子停在外面要插電（block heater），不然隔天可能發不動。車上要放刮冰器（ice scraper）。

vocab.block heater: 引擎加熱器（冬天要插電）

dialogue.en: Excuse me, the pump is asking for a postal code.
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，加油機要我輸入郵遞區號。

dialogue.en: Oh, you can prepay inside.
dialogue.zh: 喔，你可以進來店裡先付款。

dialogue.en: Can I prepay at pump three?
dialogue.zh: 我可以先付三號加油機的錢嗎？

dialogue.en: Sure. How much would you like?
Fifty dollars, regular, please.
Okay, pump three is ready.
dialogue.zh: 好，三號加油機可以加了。

dialogue.en: Do you sell washer fluid?
Yes, it's by the door.
Can I have a receipt, please?
Where can I put air in my tires?

keyPhrases.en: Do you sell an ice scraper?
My car won't start. I think it's too cold.
keyPhrases.zh: 我的車發不動，我想是太冷了。

keyPhrases.en: Do I need to plug in the car tonight?
Where is the block heater cord?
keyPhrases.zh: 引擎加熱器的插頭線在哪裡？

keyPhrases.en: Is there a car wash here?

title: 接送孫子上下學
tips: 第一次去接小孩前，請姊姊先通知學校，把爸媽加到「可以接送的人」名單（pickup list）。學校會要求看證件（護照），出門記得帶。進學校先到辦公室（office）登記。學校周圍是 School zone，要減速。

vocab.grandmother: 祖母、外婆（外公、爺爺說 grandfather）

dialogue.en: Hi, can I help you?
Hello. I'm here to pick up my grandkids.
What are their names?
Their mother is Jenny Chen. I am their grandmother.
dialogue.zh: 他們的媽媽是 Jenny Chen，我是他們的外婆。

dialogue.en: Are you on the pickup list?
Yes. My daughter called the school this morning.
dialogue.zh: 有，我女兒今天早上打電話給學校了。

dialogue.en: Can I see some ID, please?
dialogue.zh: 可以看一下你的證件嗎？

dialogue.en: Here is my passport.
Thank you. Please sign here.
I need to pick them up early today. They have a dentist appointment.
dialogue.zh: 今天我要提早接他們，他們有牙醫預約。

dialogue.en: No problem. They'll be down in a few minutes.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，他們幾分鐘後就下來。

keyPhrases.en: Excuse me, where is the office?
keyPhrases.zh: 不好意思，辦公室在哪裡？

keyPhrases.en: What time is dismissal today?
Where should I wait?
My grandchild forgot the lunch box.
Is my grandchild feeling okay?
Please call my daughter. Here is her number.
keyPhrases.zh: 請打給我女兒，這是她的電話。

title: 被警察攔下
tips: 警車在後面閃燈時：①打方向燈，安全地靠右停下。②留在車上，不要下車。③雙手放在方向盤上讓警察看到。④警察要求才拿證件，拿之前先說要拿什麼。要準備：台灣駕照、國際駕照、行照（registration）、保險卡（insurance）。開姊姊的車，要先確認車子保險有包含爸媽開車。

dialogue.en: Good afternoon. Do you know why I pulled you over?
dialogue.zh: 午安，你知道我為什麼攔你嗎？

dialogue.en: No, sorry. My English is not very good.
dialogue.zh: 不知道，抱歉，我的英文不太好。

dialogue.en: You didn't make a full stop at the stop sign.
dialogue.zh: 你在停車標誌前沒有完全停下來。

dialogue.en: I'm sorry. I'll be more careful.
Can I see your licence, registration and insurance?
dialogue.zh: 請給我看駕照、行照和保險卡。

dialogue.en: Here is my Taiwan licence and my international driving permit.
dialogue.zh: 這是我的台灣駕照和國際駕照。

dialogue.en: The registration is in the glove box. May I open it?
dialogue.zh: 行照在置物箱裡，我可以打開嗎？

dialogue.en: Go ahead. Whose car is this?
It's my daughter's car. I'm visiting her.
dialogue.zh: 這是我女兒的車，我來探親。

dialogue.en: Okay. I'll give you a warning this time.
dialogue.zh: 好，這次給你一個警告就好。

dialogue.en: Thank you, officer.

keyPhrases.en: Sorry, I don't understand. Can you call my daughter?
keyPhrases.zh: 抱歉我聽不懂，可以打給我女兒嗎？

keyPhrases.en: What is the speed limit here?
Do I need to pay this ticket?
Can I have a Mandarin interpreter, please?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以給我一位中文翻譯員嗎？

title: 車禍・拋錨・被雪困住
tips: 有人受傷馬上打 911。沒人受傷：①打開雙黃燈（hazard lights）②拍照（車損、車牌、對方駕照和保險卡）③交換資料 ④打給姊姊。車子拋錨或卡在雪裡，如果姊姊有 AMA（亞伯達汽車協會）會員，可以打電話叫拖吊或道路救援。冬天車上放毯子、手套、手電筒。

vocab.boost: 幫忙接電發動（加拿大說法）

dialogue.en: Are you okay? Is anyone hurt?
I'm okay. Nobody is hurt.
Let's exchange insurance information.
dialogue.zh: 我們交換一下保險資料吧。

dialogue.en: Okay. Can I take a picture of your licence and insurance?
dialogue.zh: 好，我可以拍你的駕照和保險卡嗎？

dialogue.en: This is my daughter's car. I will call her now.
dialogue.zh: 這是我女兒的車，我現在打給她。

dialogue.en: Hello, my car is stuck in the snow.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我的車卡在雪裡了。

dialogue.en: Where are you right now?
I'm near the Safeway on Main Street.
dialogue.zh: 我在 Main Street 的 Safeway 附近。

dialogue.en: Okay, a tow truck will be there in about an hour.
dialogue.zh: 好，拖吊車大約一小時後到。

dialogue.en: My car battery is dead. Can you give me a boost?
dialogue.zh: 我的電瓶沒電了，可以幫我接電發動嗎？

keyPhrases.en: I have a flat tire.
I need roadside assistance.
My car won't start.
Please call nine one one. Someone is hurt.
I turned on my hazard lights.

title: 超市買東西
tips: T&T 大統華是華人超市，有中文標示，買台灣食材最方便。購物袋要另外付錢，自備環保袋最好。價格常標「每磅」（per lb，1 磅約 0.45 公斤）。亞伯達只收 5% 消費稅（GST）。結帳常問會員卡：Superstore 是 PC Optimum。飲料空瓶可拿到 Bottle Depot 退押金。

vocab.PC Optimum: Superstore 等超市的集點會員卡

dialogue.en: Excuse me, where can I find rice?
Aisle seven, with the Asian foods.
dialogue.zh: 第七排，在亞洲食品那邊。

dialogue.en: Do you have soy sauce?
Hi there! Did you find everything okay?
Yes, thank you.
Do you have a PC Optimum card?
dialogue.zh: 你有 PC Optimum 會員卡嗎？

dialogue.en: No, I don't.
Do you need any bags?
No, thanks. I have my own bags.
dialogue.zh: 不用，謝謝，我自己有帶袋子。

dialogue.en: Debit or credit?
Credit. Can I tap?
Yes, go ahead. Would you like your receipt?
Yes, please.

keyPhrases.en: Is this on sale?
How much is this per pound?
I'd like to return this. Here is the receipt.
Can I get a refund?
Do you have a smaller one?
Can you help me reach that, please?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以幫我拿那個嗎？（太高拿不到）

words.zh: 熟食區（火腿、沙拉、現做食物）
快速結帳道（限少量商品）

title: 餐廳點餐
tips: 坐下來服務的餐廳要給小費，一般是 15%～20%。刷卡時機器會跳出小費選項，選一個百分比就好。速食店、自己點餐拿餐的店不一定要給。水是免費的。吃不完可以打包（Can I get a box?）。加拿大人說「洗手間」是 washroom。

dialogue.en: Hi! How many people?
Table for two, please.
Here are your menus. Can I get you something to drink?
dialogue.zh: 這是菜單，要先點飲料嗎？

dialogue.en: Just tap water, please.
What do you recommend?
The salmon is really popular.
I'll have the salmon, please. Is it spicy?
No, not at all. Would you like soup or salad with that?
dialogue.zh: 完全不辣。要配湯還是沙拉？

dialogue.en: Soup, please.
I'm allergic to peanuts.
How is everything?
Very good, thank you. Can I get a box, please?
dialogue.zh: 很好吃，謝謝。可以給我打包盒嗎？

dialogue.en: Can we have the bill, please?

keyPhrases.en: Where is the washroom?
Is the tip included?
Can we pay separately?
Not too salty, please.
Can I have a combo, please?

words.note: 加拿大菜單也常寫 Entree，也是主菜的意思。

words.zh: 肉汁起司薯條（加拿大名菜）

title: Tim Hortons 點咖啡
when: 到處都有的國民咖啡店
tips: Tim Hortons（大家叫 Tim's 或 Timmies）是加拿大的國民咖啡店。Double-double = 兩份奶精兩份糖；Regular = 一份奶精一份糖。Timbits 是一口甜甜圈球，孫子會喜歡。杯子大小 Small、Medium、Large。也可以開車到得來速（drive-thru）點。

vocab.double-double: 兩份奶精兩份糖的咖啡

dialogue.en: Hi, what can I get for you?
A medium double-double, please.
And a small coffee, black.
Anything else?
A box of ten Timbits, please.
For here or to go?
To go, please.
That'll be twelve fifty.
Here you go. Thank you!

keyPhrases.en: A large regular, please.
keyPhrases.zh: 一杯大杯 regular（一份奶精一份糖）。

keyPhrases.en: Do you have decaf?
A medium steeped tea, please.
Less sugar, please.
Can I have a hot chocolate for my grandchild?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以給我孫子一杯熱可可嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Could you warm it up, please?

title: 藥局與看醫生
tips: 觀光客沒有加拿大健保，看醫生非常貴，一定要買旅遊醫療保險，看病前先打保險公司的電話。不舒服但不緊急，可以打 811（Health Link，24 小時護理師電話，可要求中文翻譯）。一般看病去免預約診所（walk-in clinic）。藥局 Shoppers Drug Mart、London Drugs 的藥師可以推薦成藥。自己的慢性病藥要從台灣帶足四個月份量，並帶英文處方或藥單。

dialogue.en: Hello. I have a cold and a sore throat.
Do you have a fever?
No fever, but I have a bad cough.
dialogue.zh: 沒有發燒，但咳得很厲害。

dialogue.en: Are you taking any other medication?
Yes, I take medicine for high blood pressure.
Okay, this one is safe for you. Take it twice a day.
dialogue.zh: 好，這個你可以吃，一天兩次。

dialogue.en: Does it have any side effects?
Is there a walk-in clinic near here?
dialogue.zh: 這附近有免預約診所嗎？

dialogue.en: Do you have Alberta health care?
No. I'm a visitor. I have travel insurance.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我是觀光客，我有旅遊保險。

dialogue.en: Please fill out this form. The doctor will see you soon.
dialogue.zh: 請填這張表，醫生很快會看你。

keyPhrases.en: I feel dizzy.
I have diabetes.
I'm allergic to penicillin.
I ran out of my medicine. Here is my prescription.
keyPhrases.zh: 我的藥吃完了，這是我的處方。

keyPhrases.en: Can I have a Mandarin interpreter, please?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以給我一位中文翻譯員嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Can I get a receipt for my insurance?
keyPhrases.zh: 可以給我收據讓我申請保險嗎？

title: 緊急求助 911
tips: 警察、救護車、消防都打 911。接通後先說 "Mandarin"，他們會找中文翻譯。要說清楚：①發生什麼事 ②地址（把姊姊家的英文地址寫在卡片上，貼在冰箱和皮夾裡）。冬天路面結冰非常滑，老人家容易跌倒，出門穿防滑鞋。零下 20 度以下手腳容易凍傷。

dialogue.en: Nine one one. What is your emergency?
dialogue.zh: 這裡是 911，有什麼緊急狀況？

dialogue.en: Mandarin, please.
I need an ambulance.
What is your address?
My address is on this card.
dialogue.zh: 我的地址寫在這張卡上。（念卡片上的地址）

dialogue.en: What happened?
My husband fell on the ice. He can't get up.
dialogue.zh: 我先生在冰上跌倒了，站不起來。

dialogue.en: My wife has chest pain. She can't breathe.
Is he conscious? Is he breathing?
Yes, he is awake and breathing.
Stay on the line. Help is on the way.
dialogue.zh: 請不要掛電話，救援已經在路上了。

keyPhrases.en: Help! Please call nine one one!
There is a fire. There is a lot of smoke.
I'm lost. Please help me.
My wallet was stolen. I need the police.
keyPhrases.zh: 我的皮夾被偷了，我需要警察。

keyPhrases.en: I can't find my grandchild.
Please call my daughter. Here is her number.
keyPhrases.zh: 請打給我女兒，這是她的電話。

title: 問路與迷路
tips: 出門一定帶：手機（充飽電）、寫著姊姊家英文地址和電話的卡片。卡加利的地址會加方位，例如 NW、SE（西北、東南），很重要不能漏。走丟了就到商店、加油站或咖啡店請店員幫忙，比在路上問人安全。

vocab.blocks: 街區（一條街到下一條街的距離）

dialogue.en: Excuse me, I'm lost. Can you help me?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我迷路了，可以幫我嗎？

dialogue.en: Sure. Where are you going?
I want to go to this address.
Go straight for two blocks, then turn left.
dialogue.zh: 直走兩個街區，然後左轉。

dialogue.en: Sorry, can you show me on the map?
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，可以在地圖上指給我看嗎？

dialogue.en: Is it far? Can I walk there?
It's about ten minutes on foot.
Where is the nearest bus stop?
It's on the corner, across from the bank.
Could you call a taxi for me, please?
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我叫一台計程車嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Could you call my daughter for me? Here is her number.
keyPhrases.zh: 可以幫我打給我女兒嗎？這是她的電話。

keyPhrases.en: My phone has no battery.
Where is the washroom?
Is this the right way to the mall?
keyPhrases.zh: 這是去購物中心的路嗎？

keyPhrases.en: Can you write it down for me?

title: 接電話・送貨・防詐騙
tips: 加拿大常見針對長輩的詐騙：①假冒稅務局（CRA）或警察，說你欠錢要被抓，要你買禮物卡或轉帳。②「祖父母詐騙」：有人打來說是孫子出事急需用錢。遇到任何要錢、要個人資料的電話：直接掛斷，打給姊姊確認。政府機關不會用電話要你付禮物卡。有人敲門不認識，可以不開門，隔著門說話就好。

dialogue.en: Hello, may I speak to Jenny?
dialogue.zh: 你好，請問 Jenny 在嗎？

dialogue.en: Sorry, she is not home. Can I take a message?
dialogue.zh: 抱歉她不在家，需要留言嗎？

dialogue.en: Please ask her to call me back.
Okay. What is your name and number?
This is the tax office. You owe money. You must pay today with gift cards.
dialogue.zh: 這裡是稅務局，你欠錢，今天必須用禮物卡付款。

dialogue.en: I'm not interested. Goodbye.
dialogue.zh: 我沒興趣，再見。（直接掛斷）

dialogue.en: Hi, I have a package for this address.
dialogue.zh: 你好，有這個地址的包裹。

dialogue.en: Do I need to sign?
No, I can just leave it here.
Please leave it at the front door. Thank you.

keyPhrases.en: Sorry, wrong number.
My English is not good. Please call my daughter later.
keyPhrases.zh: 我英文不好，請晚一點打給我女兒。

keyPhrases.en: I don't give personal information on the phone.
keyPhrases.zh: 我不在電話上給個人資料。

keyPhrases.en: I will call you back.
Who is it, please?

title: 逛街購物與退換貨
tips: 加拿大退貨很方便，大多數店 30 天內帶收據就能退。標價不含稅，結帳時會加 5% GST。冬天外套、雪靴可以到 Mark's、Costco 買。試穿要問 fitting room（試衣間）。

dialogue.en: Hi! Can I help you find anything?
dialogue.zh: 你好！需要幫你找什麼嗎？

dialogue.en: No, thanks. Just looking.
Excuse me, I'm looking for winter boots.
They're over here. What size are you?
I'm not sure. Can I try them on?
Do you have a bigger size?
Where is the fitting room?
Does the price include tax?
No, tax is added at the register.
I'd like to exchange this for a smaller size. Here is the receipt.
dialogue.zh: 我想換小一號，這是收據。

keyPhrases.en: How much is this?
Do you have this in black?
It's too expensive. Thank you.
Is there a seniors discount?
I'll take it.
